# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Widowed  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Rachel  <sub>[v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004), [v2 c9 P15](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0015)</sub>; Mrs. Lynde  <sub>[v2 c1 P35](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0035), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Rachel Lynde is described as fat and clumsily built, waddling when she walks. She is an older woman with work-hardened hands.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)_

## Personality

Rachel Lynde is an outspoken, sharp-tongued, and blunt woman who prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor. Highly observant, almost nothing in Avonlea escapes her notice, earning her a reputation as a busybody. Despite her critical nature, she possesses a very kind heart, frequently helping the poor and demonstrating deep tenderness and patience as a nurse.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P39](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0039), [v2 c9 P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived in Avonlea for decades alongside her husband Thomas. When Anne Shirley first arrived at Green Gables, Rachel visited and bluntly criticized Anne's freckles and red hair, provoking an explosive outburst from the child. Though outraged at first, Rachel eventually accepted Anne's apology. Over the years, she maintained her close, long-standing friendship with Marilla Cuthbert and kept a vigilant eye on community happenings. She actively sought church subscriptions, such as collecting funds to buy a vestry carpet, which brought her into conflict with outspoken neighbors like Mr. Harrison. When her husband Thomas fell ill, she cared for him tenderly until his quiet death. Following his passing, she faced financial hardship due to farm mortgages and medical debts, threatening her ability to remain in Avonlea. However, Marilla invited Rachel to move into Green Gables, allowing her to stay in the community, assist with the Keith twins, and enable Anne to attend Redmond College.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017), [v2 c26 P23](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0023), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 c26 P27](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0027)_
